bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · back above the 100-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 重回 100 日均线上方

read.en: AMD rose 2.8% on Oct 26 to $531.28, trading between $514.01 and $533.50. It is above the falling 5-day ($528.7) and rising 100-day ($526.5) and 200-day ($403.7) averages, and below the falling 10-day ($544.9) and rising 30-day ($583.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and is now below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($552.65), and RSI is 43.
read.zh: AMD 10月26日上涨 2.8%，收于 $531.28，盘中区间 $514.01–533.50。股价位于下行的 5 日（$528.7）以及上行的 100 日（$526.5）和 200 日均线（$403.7）上方，低于下行的 10 日（$544.9）和上行的 30 日均线（$583.7）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，现已跌破零轴，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$552.65），RSI 为 43。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $526.5–530 zone (100-day, Oct 22 high). Resistance is $533.5–535.7 (Oct 26 high, Oct 19 low), then $544.9–548.1 (10-day, Oct 20 high) and $552.7–556.8 (SAR, Oct 21 high). Support is $526.5–530, then $514 (Oct 26 low) and $502.6–508.4 (Oct 22 and 23 lows). A close above $535.7 would target $545–553; a close below $526.5 would put $508 back in play.
